$description: Closed section-classification policy. schema/semantic_validate.validate_section_contract enforces it on every section contract and extraction/verify_all.py (check 12) asserts it. It exists so that a block cannot be classed by accident: provenance (section.source: where the evidence came from) is kept apart from taxonomy (section.semantic: what the section IS).

inlineCtaReviewed.feature.media-row: An optional secondary text link per alternating media row; the row's job is to explain one capability, so it stays a feature and the conversion block that closes the page carries the primary CTA.
inlineCtaReviewed.feature.sticky-scroll: The signature scroll story: a block may end in one xlg button (home, compare, add-ons variants) that belongs to the explained capability; the page-closing conversion block is a separate cta.* section.
inlineCtaReviewed.integrations.logo-grid: Carries only the optional 'Explore all integrations' link to the live siena.cx page (home/compare variants); the grid itself is an integrations proof block, not a conversion block.
inlineCtaReviewed.team.founders: A secondary link from the team letter to the careers page; the section's content is the founders letter and portrait, and the page-closing conversion block is a separate cta.* section.
